newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta call money stable at 9.0/9.5 percent.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta call money stable at 9.0/9.5 percent.

text.p: Jakarta call money was stable at 9.0/9.5 percent on Wednesday morning, dealers said.
They said liquidity was ample but the rate appeared to be steady in the morning although the central bank did not offer overnight papers (SBIs).
One state bank dealer said the central bank only offered SBIs for one-week and longer.

Dealers said longer-term money rates remained soft, with operators seen anticipating ample supply conditions, possibly until November 21 when underwriters refund money to unsuccessful applicants of Bank Negara Indonesia (BNI) shares.
One-month money was at 13.50/13.75 percent and three-month money at 14.00/14.75 percent.
The average overnight interbank rate on Tuesday was 9.59 percent, compared with 10.66 percent on Monday.
